Smolder.combo: Turn on Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and attack, then hit Smolder with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle to lower his armor and magic resistance and keep attacking. When Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down and he can’t escape, place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze in his escape path to slow him. Once his health is low enough, finish him with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery; don’t waste mana spamming it while he is still healthy.
Smolder.teamfight: Stay within your frontline’s and protection abilities’ range, and attack the closest enemy within Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage range. Even a healthy frontline can be dealt with using Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage’s max-health damage, so don’t move forward to target Smolder. Attack when your allies engage during the window after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down. Stop dealing damage and fall back if your frontline collapses.
Smolder.build: Smolder’s damage is mainly physical, and Kog'Maw has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to survive and build armor. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If the healing from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! can turn a fight, reduce it with Executioner's Calling.
Smolder.escape: Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is his only escape, so engage right after he uses it. If you’ve dodged Smolder W Achooo!, you can start attacking from Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage range without being slowed. Don’t follow into the area where Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! lands; move out, then engage again.
Smolder.fight: Pressure Smolder from the early game before he gains growth stacks, but only move forward when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is available and you’ve checked the enemy jungler’s position. Start with basic attacks from Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage’s increased range. If the distance closes, use Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle to lower his resistances and keep attacking. The moment after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is used is your chance to close the distance.
Smolder.laning: Smolder gains growth by hitting champions with abilities or killing enemies with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath, so avoid his poke while disrupting his farming. Pressure him with Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage in areas where your support has established vision.
Smolder.phase: In the mid-game, use Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage’s range and the items you have built to pressure turrets and objectives. Kog'Maw also deals high damage in the mid-to-late game, but this matchup gets worse over time because of Smolder’s permanent stacks, so play to end the game early.
Smolder.watch: Smolder W Achooo! slows you and grants him growth stacks on hit, so stand behind minions or dodge to the side. Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath becomes more dangerous as he gains stacks, and can execute you when your health falls below a certain percentage, so don’t continue fighting at low health. Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! deals heavy damage at the center and heals Smolder, so leave the flames, then fight again.

Ashe.laning: Save Kog'Maw E Void Ooze as a slow to escape ganks; don’t waste it on clearing the wave. Even after dodging Ashe W Volley sideways, check the enemy jungler’s position and whether Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is available before moving forward.
Ashe.teamfight: Stay within your frontline’s and protective abilities’ range, and attack the closest enemy within range with Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. Don’t walk forward to target Ashe; position with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow in mind. If your frontline falls, stop attacking and retreat.
Ashe.build: Ashe deals mostly physical damage, and Kog'Maw has low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Fit Mercurial Scimitar between your core items so you can respond if Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow immobilizes you.
Ashe.combo: When Ashe W Volley is used, activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and attack, then hit Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle to reduce her armor and magic resistance before continuing to attack. Place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze along Ashe’s retreat path to slow her and land more attacks. If a low-health Ashe escapes, cut off her path with Kog'Maw E Void Ooze and finish her with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no mobility ability, so right after Ashe W Volley is used, trade with the increased range of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, watch for the stun and be ready to remove it with Mercurial Scimitar if you’re hit. While Ashe P Frost Shot slows you as she chases, walk backward, place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze along your retreat path, and create distance.
Ashe.fight: Start trading within Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage’s range right after Ashe W Volley is used. Kog'Maw has no mobility ability, so don’t try to close the distance on foot while Ashe P Frost Shot slows you. Create distance when Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, then fight again once it wears off.
Ashe.phase: Use the increased range as Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains ranks. Kog'Maw is strong in the mid to late game once he has at least two attack speed and damage items. Keep farming even if you fall behind early, and prepare for late-game team fights.
Ashe.watch: Dodge Ashe W Volley by moving sideways; it is an area slow used to poke. Ashe P Frost Shot’s slow refreshes with each basic attack, so don’t stay in her basic attack range for long. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is a linear projectile that stuns, so change direction as you move. Don’t start a small fight from out of vision while her ultimate is available.

Ezreal.watch: Allied minions block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, so move within the wave to dodge it. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, briefly step out of range because his next attack will deal bonus damage. When your health is low, avoid lining up with allies as you retreat at an angle to dodge Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.
Ezreal.laning: Don’t use Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage to clear the wave; activate it to fight after checking the enemy jungler’s position. Save Kog'Maw E Void Ooze as a slow to escape ganks as well.
Ezreal.teamfight: Stay within your frontline’s and protective abilities’ range, and attack the closest enemy with Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. Instead of passing your frontline to reach Ezreal, attack when Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down and he comes within range. If your frontline falls, retreat instead of trying to deal damage.
Ezreal.build: Prioritize attack speed and damage items to make use of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. Ezreal Q Mystic Shot deals physical damage, while Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift deal magic damage, so don’t skew your resistances toward just one type.
Ezreal.combo: When Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down, activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and attack, then hit Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle to reduce his resistances before continuing to attack. Place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze along Ezreal’s escape route, and finish him with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery once he is low enough.
Ezreal.escape: Right after baiting out Ezreal E Arcane Shift is your chance to close the distance. Place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze along his escape route to slow him, but move behind minions to avoid Ezreal Q Mystic Shot so his mobility spell doesn’t come back quickly.
Ezreal.fight: Bait out Ezreal E Arcane Shift, then start trading with the increased range of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage while his mobility spell is down.
Ezreal.phase: In the mid game, look to trade during the window when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage’s range advantage grows. Kog'Maw peaks in the mid to late game once he has at least two attack speed and damage items, so keep farming even if you fall behind early.

Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and reaches farther than its indicator, so don’t stand directly behind a minion while Lucian is farming. When Lucian R The Culling starts, dodge to the side instead of running straight backward. If the enemy support shields or heals Lucian, or an ally is immobilized, retreat to avoid his next two empowered shots.
Lucian.build: Lucian’s main damage is physical, and Kog'Maw has low armor, so prioritize armor. Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Lucian.combo: When Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down, turn on Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and attack, then hit Lucian with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle and keep attacking. Place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze in the path of a retreating Lucian, then attack again while he is slowed. If Lucian’s health is low enough, block his escape route and finish him with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery.
Lucian.escape: The moment after Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is your window to start trading from Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage range. If Lucian approaches again, walk backward, place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze in your retreat path, and create distance.
Lucian.fight: After weathering Lucian’s initial burst, continue trading when his abilities are down. Start basic attacking from Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage’s increased range right after Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit. If Lucian keeps basic attacking, Lucian E Relentless Pursuit comes back sooner, so don’t miss that short window.
Lucian.laning: Stand to the side of Lucian Q Piercing Light’s line, and stay behind the lane’s midpoint while Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is down. Save Kog'Maw E Void Ooze for avoiding ganks instead of using it to force the wave forward.
Lucian.phase: As Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains ranks, its increased range creates more chances to trade. Kog'Maw becomes strong in the mid-to-late game once you have at least two attack speed and damage items, so keep farming even if you fall behind early.
Lucian.teamfight: Attack the closest enemy with Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage while staying within your frontline’s and protection abilities’ range. If Lucian R The Culling is aimed at you, dodge to the side. Stop attacking and fall back if your frontline collapses.

Samira.laning: Pull the lane early and farm near your turret; only move forward in areas where your support has established vision. Stay back when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is inactive, and check the enemy jungler’s position when activating it. Don’t give Samira an angle to walk in; poke with your range advantage.
Samira.teamfight: Attack the closest enemy within Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage range from behind your frontline. If an ally is immobilized, create distance because Samira can dash to them with Samira P Daredevil Impulse. If Samira uses Samira E Wild Rush to engage and nobody dies, attack then. Fall back if your frontline collapses.
Samira.escape: Right after Samira uses Samira E Wild Rush, you can attack during the window when her mobility is down. Check whether the enemy support’s immobilizing effect is also down, and place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze in Samira’s path to keep her at a distance as she tries to engage.
Samira.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Samira’s main damage is physical, and Kog'Maw has low armor, so prioritize armor.
Samira.combo: Turn on Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and start with basic attacks, then hit Samira with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle and keep attacking. If Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, wait until it ends before using projectiles and basic attacks. To finish her, block her escape route with Kog'Maw E Void Ooze, lower her health, then use Kog'Maw R Living Artillery.
Samira.fight: Start trading from the increased range when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, and don’t let Samira get into melee range. After Samira W Blade Whirl ends, use basic attacks and Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle. If Samira E Wild Rush is down and nobody has died, you have a chance to attack while keeping your distance.
Samira.phase: Use your range advantage as Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains ranks. In the mid-to-late game, once you have at least two attack speed and damage items, keep attacking with your allies’ protection.
Samira.watch: Samira W Blade Whirl blocks projectiles and basic attacks, so attack after the spin ends. If you’re hit by the enemy support’s immobilizing effect, Samira can close in with Samira P Daredevil Impulse, so dodge that initiating ability first. Samira R Inferno Trigger channels while healing her, so interrupt it immediately with an ally’s immobilizing effect or knockback if possible.

Seraphine.laning: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is inactive, stay behind the lane’s midpoint. Before moving forward, check whether W is available and where the enemy jungler is. Save Kog'Maw E Void Ooze for avoiding ganks instead of using it carelessly to clear the wave.
Seraphine.teamfight: Attack the closest enemy within Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage range from behind your frontline. Spread out to the sides so Seraphine R Encore can’t travel through an ally and reach you in the back, and stay within your allies’ protection range. Stop attacking and fall back if your frontline collapses.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets, and stuns immobilized targets. If you’re slowed, get out of the straight line in front of Seraphine and use Kog'Maw E Void Ooze to slow her pursuit. In teamfights, Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits an allied champion, so don’t stand in a line with your allies.
Seraphine.fight: The moment after you let Seraphine E Beat Drop pass is your chance to attack. When Seraphine is alone and separated from her allied marksman, turn on Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and start trading basic attacks from its increased range. Kog'Maw can’t escape on his own, so don’t recklessly close the distance while her catch abilities are available.
Seraphine.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor to defend against Seraphine’s main damage. If Seraphine’s crowd control catches you, it’s difficult to escape, so consider Mercurial Scimitar between core items. If the healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound can turn a fight, reduce it with Executioner's Calling.
Seraphine.combo: When Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, turn on Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and attack, then use Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle to lower her armor and magic resistance and keep attacking. Place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze in Seraphine’s retreat path to slow her. Only use Kog'Maw R Living Artillery repeatedly to finish her once her health is low enough.
Seraphine.escape: Immediately after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop, she has fewer ways to defend herself, giving you a chance to attack from Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage range. If Seraphine R Encore is also down, the risk of being caught is lower. Don’t chase deep just because Seraphine has no mobility.
Seraphine.phase: By mid-game, Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage has gained ranks, letting you use your range advantage. Kog'Maw peaks in the mid-to-late game once you have at least two attack speed and damage items, so keep farming even if you fall behind early.

Varus.laning: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is inactive, stand behind the middle of the lane, and check the enemy jungler’s position even when you activate it. Save Kog'Maw E Void Ooze as a slow to help you escape ganks instead of using it to force the wave forward.
Varus.teamfight: Attack the closest enemy in range of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage from behind your frontline. Spread out from your allies so Varus R Chain of Corruption doesn’t spread between several of you. If an ally is killed and Varus P Living Vengeance activates, avoid fighting briefly. If your frontline collapses, stop attacking and fall back.
Varus.watch: If you’re hit by a spell while Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks are on you, you take bonus damage based on your max health. If you’ve been hit by a few basic attacks, back off and give the stacks time to wear off. When you see Varus Q Piercing Arrow being aimed, step sideways out of its path. If an ally is caught by Varus R Chain of Corruption, move away so its tendrils can’t reach you.
Varus.escape: Varus slows himself while aiming Varus Q Piercing Arrow, so dodge its path and look for a chance to engage. Once Varus R Chain of Corruption is down, you can dodge the root and close the gap. Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, but don’t move forward if Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is down or you don’t know where the enemy jungler is.
Varus.build: Start with Cloth Armor to help you survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first because Varus primarily deals physical damage and Kog'Maw has low armor. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Varus W Blighted Quiver or Varus R Chain of Corruption.
Varus.combo: Activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and weave in basic attacks, then hit him with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle and keep attacking. When you need to back off, lay Kog'Maw E Void Ooze along the enemy’s approach path, then attack again while they’re slowed. If Varus’s health is low enough, cut off his escape path with Kog'Maw E Void Ooze and finish him with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery.
Varus.fight: Step sideways while Varus Q Piercing Arrow is being aimed, then start basic attacking from the increased range of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you can close the gap safely, hit him with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle and keep attacking. If Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks build up, don’t keep fighting; back off, then fight again.
Varus.phase: As Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains levels, your range advantage grows, so look for trades from a safe position. The mid-to-late game is Kog'Maw’s peak once you have at least two attack speed and damage items, so keep farming even if you fall behind early.

Zeri.fight: Start trading with your range advantage when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is ready and you’ve checked the enemy jungler’s position. Pressure Zeri right after Zeri E Spark Surge is down, when she has fewer ways to create distance. Don’t chase on foot once Zeri R Lightning Crash is active.
Zeri.teamfight: Stay near your frontline and within range of protective abilities, and attack the closest enemy with Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage's max-health damage lets you deal with even a high-health frontline. Don’t move forward to chase Zeri while Zeri R Lightning Crash is active. If your frontline collapses, stop attacking and retreat.
Zeri.build: Start with Cloth Armor to help you survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first because Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser deal primarily physical damage. Also keep an eye on your health so you stay above Zeri P Living Battery's execute threshold.
Zeri.combo: Activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and start with basic attacks, then hit Zeri with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle and keep attacking. If Zeri approaches, lay Kog'Maw E Void Ooze along your retreat path and land more basic attacks while she’s slowed. To finish her, cut off her escape path with Kog'Maw E Void Ooze and focus Kog'Maw R Living Artillery on her once her health is low.
Zeri.escape: The moment after you make Zeri use Zeri E Spark Surge is your chance to close the gap or catch her. Avoid positions where she can easily escape over a wall, and pressure her in open terrain. If Zeri W Ultrashock Laser is also down, attack from Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage's range with less risk of being slowed.
Zeri.laning: While Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, use Zeri’s short basic attack range to poke her. When it’s down, stand behind the middle of the lane. Save Kog'Maw E Void Ooze as a slow to help you escape ganks instead of using it carelessly to clear the wave.
Zeri.phase: As Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains levels, use your range advantage to build a lead before Zeri completes her core items. Kog'Maw gets strong in the mid-to-late game once you have at least two attack speed and damage items, but once Zeri has her core items, her mobility makes her difficult to pick off.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads and deals more damage when it hits terrain, so don’t face her with your back to a wall or in a narrow passage. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when crossing a wall, so don’t corner her against one. Give up the chase once Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, and watch out for the execute from Zeri P Living Battery when your health is low.

MissFortune.teamfight: Attack the closest enemy with Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage while staying within your frontline’s and protection abilities’ range. Don’t fight in Miss Fortune E Make It Rain; move out of the area. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, dodge to the side of the cone. Stop attacking and retreat if your frontline collapses.
MissFortune.build: Miss Fortune’s main damage is physical, and Kog'Maw has low armor, so prioritize armor. Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
MissFortune.combo: Turn on Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and start with basic attacks from the increased range, then hit Miss Fortune with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle and keep attacking. Place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze in the path of a retreating Miss Fortune; when she is slowed, add more basic attacks. Once her health is low enough, block her escape route with Kog'Maw E Void Ooze and finish her with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility, so start a fight from Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage range when Miss Fortune E Make It Rain has ended and you have vision. If she retreats with Miss Fortune W Strut, your attacks can damage her and reset the movement speed boost.
MissFortune.fight: After Miss Fortune last-hits a minion, create distance to avoid her empowered basic attack poke. Start trading from range when you have vision and can use Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. Miss Fortune has no mobility, but Kog'Maw can’t escape on his own either, so don’t recklessly move in to engage.
MissFortune.laning: Pull the lane early and farm near your turret; only move forward in areas where your support has established vision. Stand beside minions instead of directly behind them to avoid the bounce from Miss Fortune Q Double Up. Save Kog'Maw E Void Ooze for avoiding ganks instead of using it to force the wave forward.
MissFortune.phase: Use the range advantage as Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains ranks. Kog'Maw is strong in the mid-to-late game once you have at least two attack speed and damage items, so keep farming even if you fall behind early.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces off minions, so don’t stand in line with one. If Miss Fortune E Make It Rain lands, you can be slowed and hit by Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, so move out of the area. Miss Fortune R Bullet Time locks its direction when cast, so dodge to the side of the cone instead of only retreating.

TwistedFate.escape: The moment after the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is used is your chance to move forward. Kog'Maw has no mobility, so even then, don’t venture far beyond your allies’ protection.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Attack the closest enemy from within range of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, staying near your frontline and within range of protective abilities. If Twisted Fate is holding the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, stay out of his basic attack range. If you can anticipate where Twisted Fate R Destiny will land, ward the area in advance. If your frontline collapses, stop attacking and fall back.
TwistedFate.build: Build magic resistance early to prepare for Twisted Fate’s damage. Getting caught by the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is dangerous, so fit Mercurial Scimitar between your core items to give yourself a way to remove the stun.
TwistedFate.combo: Activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and weave in basic attacks, then hit him with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle and keep attacking. If Twisted Fate backs off, lay Kog'Maw E Void Ooze across his escape path to slow him, and finish him with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery when his health is low.
TwistedFate.fight: When the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is down, start trading from the increased range of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. Lowering his magic resistance with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle helps you deal more of Kog'Maw’s primarily magic damage. If the gold card is ready, use your range advantage without entering its basic attack range.
TwistedFate.laning: Early on, let the wave push toward you and farm near your turret, moving forward only while Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active. Take Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards poke from behind minions.
TwistedFate.phase: In the mid game, watch for roams with Twisted Fate R Destiny and use Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage's range advantage. Kog'Maw gets strong in the mid-to-late game once you have at least two attack speed and damage items, so keep farming and prepare for team fights.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay out of his basic attack range. Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards is area poke, so reduce the damage by standing behind minions.

Jinx.escape: Jinx has no ability to create distance on her own, and Jinx E Flame Chompers! is nearly her only way to protect herself. Start trading from Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage’s range when that ability misses or has already been used, or when Jinx W Zap! misses. Be cautious about moving forward if you can’t locate the enemy jungler.
Jinx.teamfight: From behind your frontline, attack the closest enemy within Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage’s range. Don’t leave the range of allied protective abilities to target Jinx. If your frontline falls, stop attacking and retreat. Avoid fighting right after an ally dies or a structure is destroyed and Jinx P Get Excited! triggers.
Jinx.fight: While Jinx is poking with rockets and has no minigun attack speed stacks, activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and start trading from its increased range. Fight if Jinx E Flame Chompers! misses or has already been used. You can also move forward if Jinx W Zap! misses, but check the enemy jungler’s position and the remaining duration of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
Jinx.build: Jinx deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor to withstand the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Jinx.combo: Activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and attack, then hit Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle and continue attacking. Place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze ahead along Jinx’s retreat path to slow her, then attack again. If Jinx is low enough, block her escape route with Kog'Maw E Void Ooze and finish her with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery.
Jinx.laning: Don’t overlap with minions and take the area damage from Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets together. Save Kog'Maw E Void Ooze as a slow for retreating; don’t waste it on clearing the wave.
Jinx.phase: As Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains ranks, its range advantage grows. Kog'Maw peaks in the mid to late game once he has at least two attack speed and damage items. Don’t start a fight right after Jinx P Get Excited! triggers from a takedown or structure destruction.
Jinx.watch: When Jinx farms with rockets from Jinx Q Switcheroo!, don’t stand beside minions. If you’re hit by the slow from Jinx W Zap! and the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers!, Kog'Maw has difficulty creating distance without a mobility ability. If health has been reduced, get out of range of the finisher from Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!, which deals more damage based on missing health.

Draven.phase: Kog'Maw’s damage becomes strong as Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains ranks and he gets at least two attack speed and damage items. Avoid giving Draven an early kill and scale into the late game.
Draven.build: Draven’s main damage is physical, so start with Cloth Armor to withstand it and build armor. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots, and also consider your total health when avoiding Draven R Whirling Death’s execute threshold.
Draven.combo: Throw Kog'Maw E Void Ooze where Draven’s axe will land to make it harder for him to catch. Trade by activating Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and attacking, then hitting Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, then attacking again. Once Draven is low, block his escape route with Kog'Maw E Void Ooze and finish him with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery.
Draven.escape: Look to fight when Draven E Stand Aside is down and he has one axe or fewer. Kog'Maw has no dash, so don’t force your way closer; attack from Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage’s range.
Draven.fight: Don’t fight while Draven has two axes; look for a moment when he has one or none. Place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze where an axe will land to make Draven either walk through the slow or give up the axe. Start attacking from the increased range of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage when you fight.
Draven.laning: If trading is difficult, avoid giving Draven a kill and wait for him to step forward. Don’t waste Kog'Maw E Void Ooze on clearing the wave; you also need it to escape ganks.
Draven.teamfight: Attack the closest enemy with Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage from behind your frontline and within range of protective abilities. Place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze where Draven will go to catch an axe to disrupt his axe upkeep. If your frontline falls, stop attacking and retreat.
Draven.watch: Avoid trading early while Draven has two Spinning Axes, as his basic attacks deal heavy damage. Watch for the slow and forced displacement from Draven E Stand Aside. After dodging Draven R Whirling Death once, also get out of its path as it returns. If your health is low, watch for Draven R Whirling Death’s execute.

Nilah.laning: Let the wave push toward you and farm near your turret. Only move forward when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active and you know where the enemy jungler is. Save Kog'Maw E Void Ooze to retreat if Nilah uses Nilah E Slipstream to reach you; don’t waste it clearing the wave.
Nilah.teamfight: Stay within your frontline’s and allies’ protective abilities’ range, and use Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage to attack the nearest enemy first. Spread out so multiple allies aren’t caught together by Nilah R Apotheosis. If Nilah dives on Kog'Maw, slow her along your retreat path with Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. If your frontline falls, stop attacking and retreat.
Nilah.watch: When Nilah uses Nilah E Slipstream to close the gap, Kog'Maw has no movement ability to escape, so watch the path she could dash along. Right after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, her attack range increases, so take another step back. While Nilah R Apotheosis is available, spread out from your allies so you aren’t all pulled in together.
Nilah.build: Nilah’s main damage is physical, and Kog'Maw has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to withstand her damage, then get Plated Steelcaps. Account for Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration by building health along with armor. If her healing could turn a fight around, reduce it with Executioner's Calling.
Nilah.combo: Activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and land basic attacks, then hit Nilah with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle to reduce her armor and magic resistance before continuing to attack. When Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, stop your basic attacks. When retreating, lay Kog'Maw E Void Ooze across your escape path to slow her. If Nilah flees at low health, cut off her escape path with Kog'Maw E Void Ooze and finish her with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery.
Nilah.escape: When Nilah uses Nilah E Slipstream to engage, walk backward and lay Kog'Maw E Void Ooze across your escape path. Once she’s slowed, create distance again. When moving forward to attack, look for the moment after Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil have been used, but Nilah E Slipstream can return soon, so fight only within Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage’s range.
Nilah.fight: Start with basic attacks from Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage’s range, where Nilah can’t reach you. When Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, your basic attacks miss, so stop attacking and wait for it to expire or respond with ability damage. You have an opening after Nilah uses Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil, but Nilah E Slipstream comes back quickly, so don’t chase too far.
Nilah.phase: As Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains levels and you build attack speed and damage items, Kog'Maw’s range and damage increase. Keep farming even if you fall behind early, and prepare for mid-to-late-game team fights.

Senna.escape: The moment after Senna W Last Embrace misses is your chance to close the distance. Senna E Curse of the Black Mist increases her movement speed, so don’t chase recklessly while the mist is active. Kog'Maw has no mobility, so check Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage’s range and the enemy jungler’s position before starting a fight.
Senna.fight: Dodge Senna W Last Embrace and check the enemy jungler’s position, then turn on Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and start trading basic attacks from its increased range. Senna is vulnerable to poke when she steps forward to collect a soul, but don’t move forward when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is down.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through allies or minions in a straight line, so move out of the line between Senna and her target. Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions, and if you’re marked by it, move away from allies before the root spreads. If Senna hits you once, retreat immediately to avoid giving her Mist with a second hit.
Senna.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Senna’s main damage is physical, and Kog'Maw has low armor, so prioritize armor. If the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness can turn a fight, reduce it with Executioner's Calling.
Senna.combo: Turn on Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and attack, then hit Senna with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle to lower her armor and magic resistance and keep attacking. If Senna retreats, place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze in her escape path. Once her health is low enough, finish her with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery.
Senna.laning: Watch where Senna’s souls are and poke her when she steps forward to collect one in an area where your support has established vision. Save Kog'Maw E Void Ooze as a slow to avoid ganks instead of using it carelessly to clear the wave.
Senna.phase: Trade from the increased range as Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains ranks, and come into your own in the mid-to-late game once you have at least two attack speed and damage items. Senna’s range and attack damage grow as she collects Mist, so contest her soul collection from the laning phase.
Senna.teamfight: Stay within your frontline’s and protection abilities’ range, and attack the closest enemy with Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, back away to a visible area or cast Kog'Maw E Void Ooze into the mist to slow her approach. Stop attacking and retreat if your frontline collapses.

Ziggs.teamfight: Stay within range of your frontline and protective abilities, and attack the closest enemy with Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. Don’t take paths blocked by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, and avoid grouping in one spot around objectives against Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, attack in sync with your allies’ crowd control. If your frontline collapses, fall back.
Ziggs.build: Kog'Maw’s mid-to-late-game damage is strong once you have attack speed and damage items. Build magic resistance against Ziggs’s magic damage, and get movement speed to help you walk out of warned attack areas.
Ziggs.combo: If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down and you have a route clear of mines, trade in this order: Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage → basic attack → Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle → basic attack. Lay Kog'Maw E Void Ooze across Ziggs’s retreat path to slow him, and finish him with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery once his health is low enough.
Ziggs.escape: The moment after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down is your chance to close the gap. Go in when Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield is also down or you have a clear path without mines, and keep an eye on escape routes over walls before Ziggs W Satchel Charge becomes available again.
Ziggs.fight: Once Ziggs W Satchel Charge or Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield is down, attack from the increased range of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage along a path without mines. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is still available, he can create distance with displacement or cross a wall, so don’t chase too deep.
Ziggs.laning: Move forward with Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage active after Ziggs uses a set of abilities, especially right after he uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge to poke or clear the wave.
Ziggs.phase: As Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains levels, use your range advantage. Kog'Maw reaches his strongest point in the mid-to-late game once you have at least two attack speed and damage items.
Ziggs.watch: If you step on Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, it slows you and makes his other abilities harder to dodge, so go around the mined area or wait until it disappears. When the warning area for Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb appears, move away from the center of the blast even if you can’t get out of the area completely.

Kaisa.watch: Right after being hit by Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, the mark remains, so watch for Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct’s dash. Retreat toward your allies and don’t give her an angle to engage until the mark disappears. If stacks of Kai'Sa P Second Skin have built up, the lower your health, the greater the danger, so wait out the stacks from outside her range.
Kaisa.build: Kai'Sa deals mostly physical damage, and Kog'Maw has low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor to withstand the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Kaisa.combo: Activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and start attacking from its range advantage, then hit Kai'Sa with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle and continue attacking if she closes in. If Kai'Sa chases, place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze along your retreat path to slow her and attack again. If Kai'Sa is low enough, block her escape route with Kog'Maw E Void Ooze and finish her with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery.
Kaisa.escape: While Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is down is your opportunity to pressure her with Kog'Maw.
Kaisa.fight: Trade using your range advantage when vision is secured and Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is available. While Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is down, you can pressure her without worrying about her dash. Back off when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is down or stacks of Kai'Sa P Second Skin build up.
Kaisa.laning: When Kai'Sa is likely to use Q Icathian Rain, stand near allied minions to spread out the missiles. Activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and move forward when your support has secured vision.
Kaisa.phase: As Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains ranks, its range advantage grows. Kog'Maw is strong in the mid to late game once he has at least two attack speed and damage items. Keep farming and prepare for the mid to late game even if you fall behind early.
Kaisa.teamfight: Stay within your frontline’s and protective abilities’ range, and attack the closest enemy with Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, retreat toward your allies to limit Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct’s engage angle. Place Control Wards in side brushes and approach paths before the fight to prepare for Kai'Sa E Supercharge’s stealth. If your frontline falls, stop dealing damage and retreat.

Sivir.laning: Save Kog'Maw E Void Ooze as a slow to avoid ganks instead of wasting it to push the wave. Sivir clears waves quickly, so if you need to leave lane, push beforehand or make sure an ally is ready to catch the wave.
Sivir.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and within protection range, and attack the closest enemy within Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage range. If Sivir E Spell Shield is down, your allies have a chance to catch her, but don’t move forward to target Sivir yourself. Avoid long chases while Sivir R On The Hunt is active. Stop attacking and fall back if your frontline collapses.
Sivir.watch: Watch the path of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and dodge both its outbound and return trips. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability and heals her, so don’t waste Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle or Kog'Maw R Living Artillery before it is down. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, the entire enemy team moves faster, so avoid long chases and slow retreats.
Sivir.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Sivir’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. If the healing from Sivir E Spell Shield can turn a fight, buy Executioner's Calling.
Sivir.combo: After Sivir E Spell Shield is down, turn on Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and attack, then hit Sivir with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle and keep attacking. If Sivir retreats, place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze in her escape path and add more basic attacks while she is slowed. Only finish her with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery once health has been reduced enough.
Sivir.escape: You have a chance to attack when Sivir E Spell Shield is down and Sivir R On The Hunt is inactive. Sivir has no ability to create distance on her own, so attack within Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage range and use Kog'Maw E Void Ooze to slow her retreat.
Sivir.fight: Only move forward to trade when you can activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and have checked the enemy jungler’s position. When Sivir E Spell Shield is down, use Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle to lower her resistances and keep attacking from your increased range. If Sivir R On The Hunt is active, take only short fights around terrain and vision instead of a long chase.
Sivir.phase: Use your growing range advantage as Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains ranks. Kog'Maw is strong in the mid-to-late game once you have at least two attack speed and damage items, so keep farming even if you fall behind early.

Twitch.escape: Your chance to attack comes after Twitch Q Ambush ends and reveals his position, and you’ve avoided the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask. Twitch has no way to escape once you close the gap, but Kog'Maw has no way to escape either, so fight within your allies’ protection and Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage's range.
Twitch.teamfight: Attack the closest enemy in range with Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage from behind your frontline and within your allies’ protective range. If Twitch Q Ambush ends or Twitch takes position with Twitch R Spray and Pray active, focus the same target as your allies. Spread sideways from them so you don’t all get hit by Twitch R Spray and Pray's piercing basic attacks. If your frontline collapses, stop dealing damage and retreat.
Twitch.build: Prepare a Control Ward early against Twitch Q Ambush. Twitch E Contaminate deals two types of damage, so building only one type of resistance will block only part of it. Resistance doesn’t work against the true damage from Twitch P Deadly Venom, so account for your total health, and consider ways to reduce how many basic attacks you take by lowering his attack speed.
Twitch.combo: Activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and start with basic attacks, then hit Twitch with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle and keep attacking. If Twitch approaches, walk backward and lay Kog'Maw E Void Ooze along his path to slow him, then attack again. Once his health is low enough, cut off his escape path with Kog'Maw E Void Ooze and finish him with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery.
Twitch.fight: Start basic attacking with your range advantage when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active and you have vision. Once Twitch Q Ambush ends and his position is revealed, lower his armor and magic resistance with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle and keep attacking. If Twitch W Venom Cask lands at your feet, stop trading and back off.
Twitch.laning: Early on, let the wave push toward you and farm near your turret. When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is down, stand behind the middle of the lane. Use a Control Ward for vision against Twitch Q Ambush, and avoid brush and narrow paths where you have no vision. Save Kog'Maw E Void Ooze as a slow to help you escape ganks instead of using it to force the wave forward.
Twitch.phase: In the mid game, use the growing range advantage as Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains levels. Kog'Maw peaks in the mid-to-late game once you have at least two attack speed and damage items, so keep farming even if you fall behind early.
Twitch.watch: If Twitch disappears with Twitch Q Ambush, watch for a flank and alert your allies. Leave the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask immediately. If he’s hit you with several basic attacks, Twitch E Contaminate may finish you even if you still have health, so create distance. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, its range increases and his basic attacks pierce, so move sideways out of his line of fire.

Vayne.laning: Vayne is also weak in health and armor early, so pressure her with your range advantage when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage has gained levels and your support has secured vision. Don’t move forward if Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is down or you don’t know where the enemy jungler is.
Vayne.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps early. Build armor first against Vayne’s main physical damage, but keep in mind that armor can’t reduce the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts. If getting stunned once by Vayne E Condemn would leave you certain to die, fit Mercurial Scimitar between your core items.
Vayne.combo: Activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and weave in basic attacks, then hit Vayne with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle to lower her armor and magic resistance and keep attacking. If Vayne backs off, cut off her escape path with Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. Once her health is low enough, finish her with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery; don’t waste mana spamming it at a healthy Vayne.
Vayne.escape: The moment after Vayne uses Vayne Q Tumble is your chance to close the gap or pick her off. If Vayne E Condemn is also down, the risk of being stunned against a wall is lower, so attack from within Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage's range. Don’t chase recklessly while Vayne Q Tumble is available or while Vayne R Final Hour has made her invisible.
Vayne.fight: Attack first from the increased range while Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is ready. After Vayne uses Vayne Q Tumble, you have a chance to close the gap and attack. Fight away from walls to watch out for Vayne E Condemn. If Vayne approaches, walk backward and lay Kog'Maw E Void Ooze along her path; attack again while she’s slowed.
Vayne.phase: Use the mid-game window, when Kog'Maw has the range and damage to pressure objectives and turrets. Vayne gets harder to deal with in the late game as she builds attack speed and penetration items, so focus on locking in an advantage before then.
Vayne.teamfight: Stay near your frontline and within range of protective abilities, and attack the closest enemy in range with Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. Avoid narrow passages and positions with your back to a wall so you can dodge Vayne E Condemn. During Vayne R Final Hour, watch for the moment she becomes visible to use your abilities. If your frontline collapses, stop attacking and fall back.
Vayne.watch: Don’t fight with your back to a wall, so Vayne E Condemn can’t stun you against it. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals true damage based on your max health after she attacks the same target a set number of times, so count the hits and get out of range before it procs. During Vayne R Final Hour, she briefly turns invisible with each Vayne Q Tumble, so use your abilities when she becomes visible again.

Aphelios.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so several of you don’t get hit by Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil. From within your frontline’s and protective abilities’ range, attack the closest enemy with Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. Don’t move forward to reach Aphelios; if your frontline falls, stop attacking and retreat.
Aphelios.build: Aphelios deals mostly physical damage, and Kog'Maw has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to build armor first. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If healing is enough to turn a fight, get Executioner's Calling next to reduce it.
Aphelios.combo: Activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and attack, then hit Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle to reduce armor and magic resistance before continuing to attack. If Aphelios approaches, place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze along your retreat path and attack while walking backward as he is slowed. Once Aphelios is low enough, place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze along his escape route and finish him with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery.
Aphelios.escape: When you see Gravitum’s slow, place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze along your retreat path and create distance. Aphelios has few ways to escape when he isn’t holding Severum, but Kog'Maw has no mobility ability, so fight only within your range.
Aphelios.fight: Check the next weapon shown in Aphelios E Weapon Queue System, and trade during weapon phases with low burst damage. Activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and start attacking from outside Aphelios’s range, then hit Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle to keep dealing damage as the distance closes. Don’t force an approach while Aphelios still has a way to root you.
Aphelios.laning: Stay back while Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is inactive, and check the enemy jungler’s position even when you activate it to move forward. If Aphelios’s Calibrum mark is on you, back off to preserve your health.
Aphelios.phase: Use the range advantage as Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains ranks. Kog'Maw becomes strong in the mid to late game once he has at least two attack speed and damage items. Aphelios’s strength depends on his current weapon, so check it before each fight.
Aphelios.watch: If Aphelios’s Gravitum basic attack slows you, immediately back out of range to avoid the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil explodes when it hits a champion, then triggers one extra attack with his main-hand weapon on every target hit. When he can cast it, spread out from your allies.

Kalista.laning: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is down, stay behind the lane’s midpoint, and check the enemy jungler’s position before moving forward. If several spears are embedded and your health is low, leave the lane to avoid being executed by Kalista E Rend.
Kalista.teamfight: Attack the closest enemy within Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage range from behind your frontline. Keep your formation spread out to prepare for Kalista R Fate's Call if Kalista’s bound support is nearby, and place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze where the target is likely to land. Stay within your allies’ protection; stop attacking and fall back if your frontline collapses.
Kalista.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game to withstand Kalista’s main source of physical damage. Choose Plated Steelcaps and prioritize armor.
Kalista.combo: Turn on Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and start with basic attacks. When Kalista starts her basic attack animation, cast Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle and keep attacking. If Kalista approaches, walk backward, place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze in her path, and attack again while she is slowed. If Kalista retreats at low health, block her escape route with Kog'Maw E Void Ooze and finish her with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery.
Kalista.escape: However, Kalista P Martial Poise still lets her leap, so attack from Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage range. If she approaches, slow her with Kog'Maw E Void Ooze and back away.
Kalista.fight: Turn on Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and start trading with basic attacks from the increased range. When Kalista starts her basic attack animation, cast Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle to lower her resistances, then keep attacking. Disengage before Kalista E Rend builds up too many spear stacks.
Kalista.phase: Use the range advantage as Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains ranks. Kog'Maw becomes strong in the mid-to-late game once you have at least two attack speed and damage items. Keep farming for the late game even if you fall behind early.
Kalista.watch: Watch out for the physical damage from Kalista Q Pierce and Kalista E Rend. If several spears are embedded, Kalista E Rend can take a large chunk of your health, so stop fighting and back off until the spears disappear. Keep your distance from Kalista’s bound support to avoid an engage with Kalista R Fate's Call.

Xayah.teamfight: Attack the closest enemy with Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage from within range of your frontline and protective abilities. If Xayah R Featherstorm is still available, don’t dive deep toward her first. If your frontline collapses, stop attacking and fall back.
Xayah.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots early. Build armor first because Xayah’s primary damage is physical and Kog'Maw has low armor.
Xayah.combo: Activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and start with basic attacks, then hit her with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle and keep attacking. Lay Kog'Maw E Void Ooze across Xayah’s retreat path in advance to slow her, and finish her with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery once her health is low.
Xayah.escape: If three or more feathers are positioned to return with Xayah E Bladecaller, first move out of their return path, then attack.
Xayah.fight: Take short trades using your range advantage when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is available. Xayah’s feathers build up if you fight in the same spot for too long, so attack and then reposition. Look for a chance to pressure her when Xayah R Featherstorm is down.
Xayah.laning: Save Kog'Maw E Void Ooze as a slow to help you escape ganks instead of using it carelessly to clear the wave. When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is down, stand behind the middle of the lane.
Xayah.phase: As Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains levels, your range advantage grows, and Kog'Maw peaks in the mid-to-late game once you have at least two attack speed and damage items.
Xayah.watch: If Xayah E Bladecaller hits you with three or more returning feathers, it roots you. If three or more feathers form a line between you and Xayah, walk sideways out of their return path instead of moving straight back.

Caitlyn.teamfight: Stay within your frontline’s and protective abilities’ range, and attack the closest enemy within Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage’s range. Don’t move forward to target Caitlyn; if your frontline falls, stop attacking and retreat.
Caitlyn.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Caitlyn’s main damage is physical, and Kog'Maw has low armor, so build armor first.
Caitlyn.combo: Place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze along Caitlyn’s retreat path, and finish her with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery once she is low enough.
Caitlyn.escape: Check your path to avoid Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, and look for an opening when you see Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker’s cast animation.
Caitlyn.fight: Activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and start attacking from its increased range, but only move forward after checking the enemy jungler’s position.
Caitlyn.laning: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is inactive, stay behind the middle of the lane. Don’t waste Kog'Maw E Void Ooze on clearing the wave so you can use it to escape ganks.
Caitlyn.phase: As Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains ranks, its range advantage grows. Kog'Maw becomes strong in the mid to late game once he has at least two attack speed and damage items.
Caitlyn.watch: If you step on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, you’re rooted in place and exposed to Caitlyn P Headshot’s long range and empowered attack. Watch for traps in brush and narrow paths, and take Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker’s poke from behind allied minions.

Yasuo.escape: Your opening to engage comes right after Yasuo throws his tornado and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s stacks reset. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t follow just because one movement ability has been used. Look for an opportunity with your allies’ crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath is available again.
Yasuo.build: Withstand the early game with Cloth Armor, and get Plated Steelcaps for boots. Yasuo’s main damage is physical, and Kog'Maw’s armor is relatively low, so build armor first.
Yasuo.combo: If Yasuo reaches you, walk backward and lay Kog'Maw E Void Ooze across your escape path. Once he’s slowed, resume your basic attacks. To finish him, cut off his escape path with Kog'Maw E Void Ooze, then repeatedly cast Kog'Maw R Living Artillery once his health is low enough.
Yasuo.fight: Use light poke to break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield before trading in earnest. When Yasuo throws his tornado and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s stacks reset, start attacking with the increased range from Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is still there, look for an angle to go around it or save key abilities until it disappears.
Yasuo.laning: Manage the wave so Yasuo has fewer minions to use as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, and stand behind the lane’s center when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is inactive. Before moving forward, check both Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage’s cooldown and the enemy jungler’s position.
Yasuo.phase: As Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains levels, you can use your range advantage. Kog'Maw becomes stronger in the mid to late game as you build two or more attack speed and damage items, so keep farming even if you fall behind early.
Yasuo.teamfight: Stay within your frontline’s and allies’ protective abilities’ range, and use Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage to attack the nearest enemy first. If Yasuo dives on you, retreat and lay Kog'Maw E Void Ooze across your escape path. If your frontline falls, stop attacking and retreat.
Yasuo.watch: If Yasuo hits Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice in succession, his next use can knock you up. When its stacks are full, move off the line of attack and dodge to the side. If Yasuo uses Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to dash through minions and approach, Kog'Maw has no movement ability and is easy to hit with follow-up attacks, so keep your distance. When Yasuo W Wind Wall is up, go around it or save key abilities until it disappears.

Jhin.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Jhin’s main damage is physical, and Kog'Maw has fairly low armor, so build armor first.
Jhin.combo: While Jhin is reloading, activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and attack, then hit Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle to reduce his armor and magic resistance before continuing to attack. If Jhin retreats, place Kog'Maw E Void Ooze along his escape route and finish him with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery once he is low enough.
Jhin.escape: Jhin has no ability to create distance on his own, so avoid the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish; his reload is your chance to close in. Don’t engage if Jhin’s final shot remains or right after you step on a Jhin E Captive Audience trap.
Jhin.fight: When Jhin is reloading or right after he fires one or two shots, activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and start trading within range. Back off if Jhin’s final shot remains. Before moving forward, check whether Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is available and where the enemy jungler is.
Jhin.laning: Stand one space away from low-health minions to avoid the empowered bounce of Jhin Q Dancing Grenade after it kills a target. Save Kog'Maw E Void Ooze as a slow to escape ganks; don’t waste it on an aggressive wave clear.
Jhin.phase: As Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains ranks, its range advantage grows. Kog'Maw becomes strong in the mid to late game once he has at least two attack speed and damage items. Keep farming if you fall behind early and aim for that power spike.
Jhin.teamfight: From behind your frontline, attack the closest enemy within Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage’s range. When advancing toward Jhin, let your frontline go in first so they can absorb Jhin W Deadly Flourish and traps. If someone has to block a Jhin R Curtain Call shot, the ally with the highest health percentage should take it. If your frontline falls, stop attacking and retreat.
Jhin.watch: Jhin’s final shot deals heavy damage, so back off while it remains. Right after being hit by a Jhin P Whisper basic attack or a Jhin E Captive Audience trap, move out of a straight line to avoid the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish. When your health is low, prioritize dodging Jhin R Curtain Call, which deals more damage based on missing health.

Tristana.combo: After Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, activate Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage and weave in basic attacks, then hit her with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle and keep attacking. If Tristana backs off, lay Kog'Maw E Void Ooze across her escape path to slow her. Finish her with Kog'Maw R Living Artillery once her health is low enough.
Tristana.escape: The moment you make Tristana use Tristana W Rocket Jump is your chance to close the gap or catch her. Kog'Maw has no mobility, so look for an opening within Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage's range. If Tristana R Buster Shot is still available, she can knock you back, so don’t force your way in.
Tristana.fight: Don’t move forward while Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are available. Once Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, start trading from the increased range of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage. If Tristana jumps in, walk backward and lay Kog'Maw E Void Ooze across your retreat path to slow her.
Tristana.laning: Stand away from allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge when she kills a minion. When your support has secured vision in the area, push the wave to make it harder for Tristana to last-hit under her turret.
Tristana.phase: Kog'Maw’s damage ramps up as Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage gains levels and you build attack speed and damage items. Some data suggests that a fully built Tristana is difficult to handle, though, so use any safe advantage you gain instead of automatically waiting until late game.
Tristana.teamfight: Attack the closest enemy in range of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage from behind your frontline. If an enemy jumps in with Tristana W Rocket Jump, back away and lay Kog'Maw E Void Ooze along their path. Tristana W Rocket Jump may reset when an ally goes down, so retreat immediately and stay within range of your allies’ protective abilities.
Tristana.watch: Tristana W Rocket Jump closes the gap and resets its cooldown if she gets a takedown, so back off as soon as an ally goes down. Watch out for the stun and knockback from Tristana R Buster Shot, and stand away from allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge.
